steps.text: Bring water and chicken bouillon granules to a boil in a large pot. Add broccoli and onion; cook at a boil until tender, 10 to 12 minutes.

Combine milk, cream cheese, margarine, and flour in a second large pot over medium heat. Cook and stir until margarine melts and mixture begins to thicken, about 5 minutes. Stir in Cheddar cheese until melted completely.
Pour broccoli mixture into cheese mixture; stir well.

raw_recipe.headline: Erin's Cheesy Broccoli Soup
raw_recipe.description: Cream cheese is the secret ingredient in this delicious and creamy broccoli soup with Cheddar cheese and onion.
raw_recipe.name: Erin's Cheesy Broccoli Soup

Pour broccoli mixture into cheese mixture; stir well.

review.reviewBody: I made some modifications and certainly, feel with those it's a 5-star. First, I melted the butter in a large pan, then sauted onion, minced celery, grated carrot, garlic and shallot, as I think this was the main reason for the flavor, without it, I think it would be lacking. I then added some white pepper and salt. After the veggies softened, I added only about 2 or 2 1/2 T flour, which ended up being plenty to thicken this. I like the idea of dry mustard, but did not have any on hand or would have added it. I whisked in the milk, slowly till well combined. I then added in the cooked broccoli that I had cooked in vegetable stock. I then pureed this a bit with an immersion blender. I then added the softened (room temp) cream cheese (only used about 4 oz) and whisked that in. I added the cheddar cheese (more like 1 1/2 cups) and stirred to melt it. I had reserved a bit of the cooked broccoli and chopped it small, to add some texture to the soup, which was really nice. I served this in mini bread bowl, big hit with the kids, for fun-factor! The base idea of this recipe is really good, mostly because it does not call for process cheese food or to add a can of 'cream of something' soup, but is much more HOMEMADE.

This is a very good soup base. I used fresh broccoli and added celery and carrots and a sprinkle of white pepper and garlic powder. Also, I cook the flour and butter (not margarine) together first to make a roux then add the milk and then the cream cheese and cheddar for a nice cheese sauce which I then pour into the pot of vegetables. I also use an immersion blender to chop up the veggies while leaving small chunks because I am making this for an elderly relative and that helps with eating. I've frozen it for travel and delivery and it's turned out very well.

I guarantee this will be one of the best broccoli cheddar soups you will ever make! Add a couple of garlic cloves to the veggie mixture before boiling and some bacon bits to the creamy mixture then blend both pots together with and emersion blender! Serve in bread bowls and you will surely be overly impressed with this meal

I used my own homemade chicken stock and about 1 1/2 cups good sharp cheddar.I also slightly browned the onions first with a little butter to give it a little more depth of flavor then added the onions to the broccoli after it was cooked. Next I used my immersion blender but I left lots of chunks of broccoli. The soup turned out thick and creamy and they loved the bits of whole broccoli. Great quick soup.

I'm only rating this a 4 b/c it is VERY rich! I would cut back the butter & cream cheese by 1/3. Per another review, I too sautéed the onion. 1 celery, 2 garlic, 2 shallots, & 2 carrots; then added flour & cooked a bit. Thin out with broth from broccoli water. Add milk to broccoli. Add onion mixture to broccoli. Melt cream cheese & cheddar cheese in soup. Added red pepper flakes & Siracha for a bit more flavor. Very good! Serve with crusty sour dough bread & a salad.

This was so delicious and creamy! My family's new favorite soup! I did what others did and melted the butter in a large pan and sautéed the onion before adding the other ingredients. I also used an immersion blender and pureed the broccoli then I added another cup of cheese. This is quick and easy and most of all...SO good!

I had some fresh broccoli that was slightly yellowing and so I searched for the right soup recipe and found this one. It's GREAT! Only giving it 4 stars because I too made some slight modifications. First, I used half the amount of Cream Cheese (4 oz) and doubled the Cheddar Cheese (2 c) and used butter instead of margarine. Also, Step #2 should almost be Step #1 as the Cream Cheese takes a bit to melt down. I love another reviewer's suggestion to add White Pepper, I used Black Pepper because I was out of White and I also sprinkled in just a pinch of Garlic Powder. DELISH!

This is an excellent recipe for flavor and quality. I will note that step 2 seems to mash several steps into one. We found this recipe works best if, at step 2, we start by melting the butter then whisking in the flour to make a roux. Then we gradually added the milk. The cream cheese works best if cut into smaller chunks. I'm sure most here know these sorts of things easily, but as a less-experienced cook I had to find out these techniques outside the recipe.

Note, if you do those well, this recipe is among the most amazing broccoli cheese soup I've had.

My daughter and I LOVED this recipe. I did make a few changes due to lack of all of the ingredients and it turned out delicious. I only had 2% milk so I used all milk and no water. I didn't have any butter or cheddar cheese, so I added the rest of the cheese I did have on hand which was a couple slices of American cheese, a couple tablespoons of fresh parmesan and a couple tablespoons of mozzarella. I also added about a half package of dry Knorr vegetable soup mix. I also pureed the onions and the broccoli hoping maybe my hubby would eat it, but that was a no go (unfortunately he doesn't eat many veggies at all so I wasn't surprised). It was so delicious! Thank you for the recipe!

Excellent!! Best broccoli cheddar soup yet!! Sautéed onions in butter and a couple of crushed garlic cloves, then added flour, milk, 1/2 brick cream cheese and 1/2 large brick of old cheddar and about 1/2 cup shredded Balderson cheese....boiled broccoli in chicken stock then added to cheese mixture. Everyone had seconds. Will defiantly make again and again Thaks for a delicious recipe!!
Added, grated carrot, celery & onion. Also added some leftover Christmas ham.This recipe was super easy & ohhh. So delish! Hubby requested to make it again with the modifications.
This is a wonderful soup. The only thing I do differently is add 4 cups of water instead of 3. So yummy my family loves it with some grilled cheese sandwiches.
Awesome!!

Delicious. I just wasn't sure how much a "bunch" of broccoli is. I took a guess and ended up with about 4 cups after chopping. I think I'd like to try adding some larger cooked pieces just for variety.
Definitely take again. Easy and flavorful.
Easy recipe to make. Tastes good
I added bacon and you can only imagine how good it was on cold night.
Very good. Very easy.

I love this delicious recipe! I so appreciate that this can be prepared on the stovetop. I’ve always used fresh broccoli and that is time-consuming but so worth it. The first time I made it I had goat cheese on hand that substituted for the cream cheese, and since then have substituted cheeses based on what I’ve had in the fridge. This easy soup recipe has been foolproof and it’s always enjoyed by all!
Perfection.
